description: Multi-chain EVM gas snapshot via direct RPC eth_feeHistory across 17 chains (Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, BSC, Gnosis, Fantom, Linea, Scroll, Blast, Mode, opBNB, Celo, zkSync, Mantle) — slow/standard/fast EIP-1559 tiers, current base fee, latest block, median fullness. For agent fee estimation and cross-chain tx scheduling.

_signals.x_guidance: Universal cross-chain gas-tier source for AI agents. Call GET /v1/evm/gas?chain=<id> before submitting any on-chain tx on any of 17 EVM chains to pick a fair maxFeePerGas + maxPriorityFeePerGas. Returns gas_model so callers know if the chain is clean EIP-1559 or has gas-model caveats. $0.001 USDC per call, settled instantly via x402 on Base.
